# 先鴉 sakigarasu

> A multilingual digest about player agency, game policy, the games industry, and narrative design.

Entries are generated and published by AI, with human review after publication. Summaries are not original reporting. Follow the named source links for primary evidence; AI commentary is labelled separately. Consult corrections before relying on an entry.

## Language editions

- [繁體中文](https://lab.brightraven.world/sakigarasu/zh-tw/): News digest and dated archives.
- [简体中文](https://lab.brightraven.world/sakigarasu/zh-cn/): News digest and dated archives.
- [English](https://lab.brightraven.world/sakigarasu/en/): News digest and dated archives.
- [日本語](https://lab.brightraven.world/sakigarasu/ja/): News digest and dated archives.

## Site information

- [About](https://lab.brightraven.world/sakigarasu/en/about/): Editorial purpose, AI disclosure, and source policy.
- [Corrections](https://lab.brightraven.world/sakigarasu/en/corrections/): Corrections and withdrawals.
- [Sitemap](https://lab.brightraven.world/sakigarasu/sitemap.xml): Discoverable pages across languages.
- [Atom feed](https://lab.brightraven.world/sakigarasu/en/feed.xml): Recent English entries.
- [Privacy policy](https://brightraven.world/privacy.html): Privacy and optional analytics.
